ACC-10234.issue: Garage motion sensor going offline intermittently
ACC-10234.resolution: Replaced battery; advised that battery below 10% can cause the sensor to drop off Wi-Fi. Recommended proactive replacement.

ACC-30456.issue: Side door lock unresponsive to app commands for ~10 minutes at a time
ACC-30456.resolution: Identified Wi-Fi router channel congestion; had customer move to a less congested 2.4GHz channel, issue did not recur during follow-up.
